title: Stop Playing the Guessing Game! Target-free User Simulation for Evaluating Conversational Recommender Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance of Conversational Recommender Systems (CRSs) on a randomly sampled 'selected set' of target items versus a 'residual set', and analyzing how evaluation metrics (like Recall@K) are artificially inflated when using target-biased user simulators that are pre-encoded with specific target item attributes.
